title: Add modem regression and property tests
description:
Add modem-level invariants, round-trip tests, and regression coverage for the migrated public entry points.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The shared modem surface has regression coverage for standard presets and migrated compatibility entry points.
- [ ] Property tests cover relevant round-trip or labeling invariants where appropriate.
- [ ] The new tests protect both the reference path and the optimized path from divergence.

## Notes

This task extends the earlier reference tests into full framework-level regression protection.
